## Layout

A street is two rows of assemblers sharing two belts (4 lanes). Cells are 4 tiles apart (3-tile assembler + 1 gap).

```
y=-2   chests (north row)
y=-1   output inserters
y=0..2 north row               gap column: poles above/below, a sideways hand-over inserter in the middle
y=3    inserters: near belt (x+1), far belt long-handed (x+2), feeder output (x)
y=4    belt [lane N | lane S]
y=5    belt [lane N | lane S]
y=6    inserters (south row)
y=7..9 south row
y=10   output inserters
y=11   chests
```

- **Feeder cells** make intermediates that are not on the bus (gears, pipes) and put them on the street belt instead of a chest.
  - A north feeder fills the y=4 south lane, a south feeder the y=5 north lane.
  - They sit at the west end, so their product passes every cell.
- **Hand-over**: the inserter in the middle of a gap puts a cell's product straight into its neighbour.
  - Examples: belt → underground/splitter, inserter → long-handed/fast, AM1 → AM2, engine → pump/car, storage tank → fluid wagon.
- `check()` in `lib/mall.py` verifies at generation time that every ingredient of every cell comes from a lane or a neighbour.

### Logistics & mining street (default file)

- Lanes: y=4 [iron | gears (feeder)], y=5 [green circuits | steel]
- North row: gear feeder ×2, underground belt, belt, splitter, long-handed, inserter, fast inserter, pipe-to-ground, pipe
- South row: repair pack, steel chest, AM2, AM1, electric mining drill, radar, rail signal, chain signal, iron chest, magazine

### Power, fluids & trains street (`variants/power-fluids-trains-*.txt`)

- Lanes: y=4 [iron | gears (feeder)], y=5 [pipes (feeder) | steel]
- North row: gear feeder, steam engine, offshore pump, pipe-to-ground, fluid wagon, storage tank, cargo wagon, burner inserter, belt, flamethrower
- South row: pipe feeder ×2, pump, engine, car, engine, pump, steel chest, iron chest, light armor
- Only two bus taps: iron and steel.

## Upgrading

| Stage | Belts | Assemblers | Inserters | Poles | Chests |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| early | yellow | AM1 | basic | small | iron |
| mid | red | AM2 | fast | medium | iron |
| late | blue | AM3 | bulk | medium | passive provider |

- Underground spans ≤3, small-pole spacing.
- Chests are limited to 2 slots so the mall does not hoard. It idles most of the time, so marker counts are **capped at one lane (450/min)**.
- Mall cells need few items per machine, so the far belt uses long-handed inserters. They are not a bottleneck, which keeps them within the upgrade rules.
